subject: Multitenant carveout & support safeguard — commercial questions
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@novacare.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: tom.lee@novacare.com, procurement@novacare.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multitenant carveout & support safeguard — commercial questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's inference routing and the observability surface. Before we move to an internal approval, procurement wants clarity on two items in the Private Deployment (VPC) proposal:

1) Multitenant carveout: we currently host multiple product lines in a shared cluster. We need a contractual assurance that any platform-fee calculations exclude a temporary sandbox tenant (used for partner integrations) and that there is a reasonable process to request an exception without triggering a platform fee uplift.

2) Incident response / SRE credits: we are asking for 10 hours/month of SRE on-call credits to be applied during the first 6 months post go-live (for migration/triage) — can Redwood convert implementation credits or platform fee dollars into an on-call retainer?

Attached is a short procurement packet with the items procurement flagged. Can you outline the commercial guardrails and whether the support tiers can be adjusted or split for a multitenant setup? Also include any DocuSign/PO process expectation so we can plan internal timelines.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Head of Procurement — NovaCare Systems

Attachment: Novacare-MA-questions.pdf (1 page — procurement checklist)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@novacare.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multitenant carveout & support safeguard — commercial questions

Sarah — appreciate the clear asks and thanks for the packet. Quick answers up-front, then details below:

- Multitenant carveout: yes, we can define a temporary "sandbox tenant" carveout for the first 90 days post-migration; beyond that we treat tenants per the committed node/volume SKU unless explicitly carved out in the SOW. We can add a 30-day review window to reclassify the tenant if needed.
- SRE/on-call credits: we can reallocate up to 40% of the implementation credit toward an on-call retainer during the first 6 months. Alternatively, we can offer a capped number of incident-response credits (8–12 hrs/month) as a credit line against the platform fee for the pilot period.

Options for commercial language (high-level):
- Option A (short pilot carveout): 90-day sandbox carveout; implementation credit converts 35% to on-call retainer; platform fee amortized over 12 months.
- Option B (extended safeguard): 180-day carveout, 50% conversion to on-call retainer, and a one-time migration credit applied to first invoice.

I pulled in Marissa (commercial lead) to shape the discount and Irene (legal) to pre-check whether the carveout language will need sign-off as a schedule rather than a simple clause. Marissa — can you propose a financial counter (high-level) we can present to NovaCare? Irene — can you flag any legal roadblocks on the carveout wording?

Next steps: would NovaCare be open to Option A as a starting point? If yes, we can prepare a short SOW amendment and a DocuSign link for signatures by early next week.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Novacare-MA-questions.pdf referenced above

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multitenant carveout & support safeguard — commercial questions

Jonas / Marissa,

Quick legal read: carveouts are doable but we should structure them as a short-term Schedule A to the Master Agreement (MA) with explicit reclassification triggers and a sunset review. Practical suggestions:

- Define "Sandbox Tenant" precisely (tenant ID list + CIDR or production flag) and limit to non-production workloads.
- Sunset clause: sandbox carveout persists for either 90 days or until NovaCare certifies the tenant as production-ready (whichever comes first).
- Reclassification process: 30-day written notice; Redwood may elect to reclassify earlier if usage exceeds agreed thresholds (we'll include usage thresholds).

Credits / on-call conversion: we can permit conversion up to 40% of implementation credits into an SRE retainer for the first 6 months. Operational note: we must cap the monthly hours and define escalation SLAs (P1, P2 response windows) in the SOW.

Redlines: attached is a short markup (legal_redlines_v1.pdf) that demonstrates schedule language, suggested thresholds, and the incident credit table. Two items to confirm with product before sending to NovaCare:
1) Max monthly on-call hours you are willing to guarantee under the retainer (we suggest 8 hours/month as a conservative starting point).
2) Whether the sandbox will have access to the same failover fallback (cross-tenant routing) — product may want to restrict fallback behavior for sandbox tenants.

Marissa: once we have the finance counter, I can produce a Schedule A draft.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_redlines_v1.pdf (3 pages — proposed schedule and credit table)

From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@novacare.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: tom.lee@novacare.com, procurement@novacare.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multitenant carveout & support safeguard — commercial questions

Jonas / Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the clarity on options. NovaCare prefers Option A with two small edits:

1) We request the sandbox carveout be extended to 120 days (rather than 90) to cover a longer partner integration cycle.
2) We accept the 35% conversion to an on-call retainer but ask that the retainer guarantee at least 10 hours/month for months 1–3, sliding to 6 hours/month for months 4–6.

If Redwood can accept those two edits we can proceed:
- Procurement will sign a short SOW amendment and issue a PO.
- Please send a DocuSign link for the Schedule A + updated SOW.

Tom and I will target signatures by EOD next Wednesday once the amended SOW is in DocuSign. If you can push a draft SOW / schedule now, we can expedite internal review.

Best,
Sarah Mills
Head of Procurement — NovaCare Systems

P.S. DocuSign link (for reference): https://www.docusign.com/single-sign?env=demo&doc=7890

Attachment: sow-draft.docx (SOW skeleton — implementation timeline and milestone list)
